description: This file declares classes, protocols, and macros for an object-oriented logging system, including the main logger class (GTMLogger), log levels, log writers, formatters, and filters. It provides interfaces for configuring and using a flexible, thread-safe logging framework with support for custom log output, formatting, and filtering.

classes.name: GTMLogger
classes.description: Main logging class providing methods for logging at different levels, configuration of writers, formatters, and filters, and support for shared logger instance.

classes.name: GTMLogBasicFormatter
classes.description: A simple formatter that formats log messages similar to NSLog or printf.

classes.name: GTMLogStandardFormatter
classes.description: A formatter that prepends timestamp and process info to log messages.

classes.name: GTMLogLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters out debug level messages in non-debug builds.

classes.name: GTMLogNoFilter
classes.description: A filter that allows all messages through.

classes.name: GTMLogAllowedLevelFilter
classes.description: Base class for level-based filters, managing allowed levels.

classes.name: GTMLogMininumLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters out messages below a specified minimum level.

classes.name: GTMLogMaximumLevelFilter
classes.description: Filters out messages above a specified maximum level.

classes.name: NSFileHandle (GTMFileHandleLogWriter)
classes.description: Category adding log writing capability to NSFileHandle.

classes.name: NSArray (GTMArrayCompositeLogWriter)
classes.description: Category allowing an array of log writers to be used as a composite log writer.

classes.name: GTMLogger (GTMLoggerLogWriter)
classes.description: Adapter category enabling GTMLogger to be used as a log writer.

methods.name: sharedLogger
methods.description: Returns the shared singleton instance of GTMLogger.

methods.name: setSharedLogger:
methods.description: Sets the shared singleton instance of GTMLogger.

methods.name: standardLogger
methods.description: Creates a standard logger that logs to stdout with default formatter and filter.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithStderr
methods.description: Creates a standard logger that logs to stderr.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithStdoutAndStderr
methods.description: Creates a logger routing levels >= error to stderr and others to stdout.

methods.name: standardLoggerWithPath:
methods.description: Creates a logger that writes to a specified file path.

methods.name: loggerWithWriter:formatter:filter:
methods.description: Creates a logger with custom writer, formatter, and filter.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Creates a logger that logs to stdout with basic formatting and no filter.

methods.name: initWithWriter:formatter:filter:
methods.description: Designated initializer for GTMLogger with specified writer, formatter, and filter.

methods.name: logDebug:
methods.description: Logs a message at debug level.

methods.name: logInfo:
methods.description: Logs a message at info level.

methods.name: logError:
methods.description: Logs a message at error level.

methods.name: logAssert:
methods.description: Logs a message at assert level.
